installIntro.message: 下載影片與 MP3 需要在你的電腦上安裝 yt-dlp（下載影片的開源工具）、ffmpeg（合併影音與轉 MP3）與 deno（yt-dlp 需要的執行環境），以及本專案的小幫手（讓瀏覽器能使用它們）。全部約 150 MB，只裝在你的帳號下，可以隨時移除。

installDetailYtDlp.message: 從 yt-dlp 官方 GitHub 正式版本下載 yt-dlp，並驗證官方檢查碼：

installDetailDeno.message: 從 deno 官方 GitHub 正式版本下載 deno，並驗證官方檢查碼：

updatesUnsupported.description: Shown when status has no update information (older helper).

uninstallDesc.message: 刪除小幫手、由它安裝的 yt-dlp、ffmpeg、deno 與記錄檔，以及瀏覽器中的註冊。已下載的影片不受影響，你自己安裝的工具（例如 Homebrew 裝的）也不會被刪除。

uninstallDialogDesc.message: 將刪除小幫手、yt-dlp、ffmpeg、deno 與記錄檔。已下載的影片會留在原本的位置。之後可以隨時用安裝指令重新安裝。

uninstallDone.message: 已移除下載功能。已下載的影片仍在原本的資料夾。

uninstallFailed.message: 無法移除下載功能。請確認小幫手已安裝後再試一次。

quickHeightBest.description: One-click download: the 'best quality' default video quality.

quickSpecMp4.description: One-click download: default quality and format, e.g. 1080p MP4.

quickSpecAny.description: One-click download: default quality with any format (may be WEBM).

quickTooltip.description: Toolbar tooltip of the Video and MP3 buttons when one-click download is on.

quickSummary.description: One-click download panel: the format being downloaded and its size, e.g. 1080p60 MP4, ~320 MB.

quickPreparing.description: One-click download panel: shown while the video information is loading.

quickChangeQuality.description: One-click download panel: cancels this download and shows the full quality list.

quickChangeBitrate.description: One-click MP3 panel: cancels this download and shows the full MP3 options.

quickAgain.description: One-click download panel: starts the same download again after it finished or was cancelled.

optionsQuickTitle.description: Settings page: heading of the one-click download options.

optionsQuickDownloadDesc.message: 點工具列的「影片」或「MP3」就以下方的預設值直接開始下載；MP3 使用上次選擇的位元率。關閉時每次都先選再下載。
optionsQuickDownloadDesc.description: Settings page: one-click download switch description.

optionsDefaultHeight.description: Settings page: default quality for one-click and right-click downloads.

optionsDefaultHeightDesc.message: 影片沒有這個畫質時，使用比它低的最高畫質（全部都比它高時用最低的）；有多個幀率時用最高幀率。

optionsDefaultContainer.description: Settings page: default format for one-click and right-click downloads.

optionsContainerMp4.description: Settings page: default format option MP4.

optionsContainerAny.message: 不限格式（最高畫質可能是 WEBM）
optionsContainerAny.description: Settings page: default format option any.

optionsDefaultMark.description: Settings page: marks the default choice in a list.

quickStart.description: Download panel: starts a one-click download with the default quality, e.g. Start download (1080p MP4).

quickInstalled.description: Download panel: shown once the helper is detected after the install guide was shown.

menuDownloadVideo.description: Right-click menu on video links: downloads the video with the default quality.

menuDownloadMp3.description: Right-click menu on video links: downloads the audio as MP3.

notifyStarted.description: Notification after a right-click download starts (the video ID until the title is known).

notifyAlreadyDownloading.description: Notification when the same right-click download is already running.

notifyNeedHelper.message: 下載影片需要先安裝小幫手
notifyNeedHelper.description: Notification title when a right-click download needs the helper.

notifyNeedHelperBody.message: 點這裡打開設定頁的安裝說明。
notifyNeedHelperBody.description: Notification text when a right-click download needs the helper.

optionsContextMenu.message: 在影片連結的右鍵選單顯示下載選項

optionsContextMenuDesc.message: 在 YouTube 的影片連結（首頁、搜尋結果、推薦、播放清單）按右鍵，就能以上方的預設值下載，不用點進影片。
optionsContextMenuDesc.description: Settings page: right-click menu switch description.

jobsOtherVideos.description: Download panels: heading of the downloads of other videos (for example started from the right-click menu).
